# manta_cloudinit_group (Resource)

Add one or more new groups to cloud-init.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "manta_cloudinit_group" "compute" {
  name        = "compute"
  description = "The compute group"
  file = {
    content  = file(var.filename_cloud_init_group)
    encoding = "base64"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file` (Map of String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
